name: Gen
source:
The police superintendent’s daughter.

Loyal to a fault, Gen can be a little emotionally unstable. She falls in love with the protagonist after he saves her life and is willing to do anything for him.

Although she is the daughter of the police superintendent, she does not want to hide behind her father and as a result tends to get herself mixed up in dangerous situations.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiagirl]Google Play[/url]]
